readings.Aries: Your half-life in any comfortable situation is shorter than you'd like to admit. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Taurus: Your senses are your instruments. When did you last use them on something purely for enjoyment? Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Gemini: There is more continuity in you than your reinventions suggest. Find what runs through all of them. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Cancer: You carry the emotional history of everyone you love. Set some of it down today. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Leo: The thing you're proud of deserves to be shared. Not to impress — because it's genuinely good. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Virgo: Something you wrote off as not worth your time deserves a second look with less judgment. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Libra: The beauty you seek in your environment is also something you create in everyone around you. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Scorpio: There is something you need to grieve before you can desire again. Let yourself. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Sagittarius: Something you've been calling freedom is starting to look like avoidance from a certain angle. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Capricorn: The plan is good. The plan will need adjustment. Plan for that too. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Aquarius: You process the world through systems. There is one person who doesn't fit the system and you keep thinking about them. That's data. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Pisces: Your gift for reading what people need has been extended to everyone except yourself. Read yourself. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.

Aries-Virgo.synthesis: The slow materials and the fast energy can build something neither could alone. Patience is required from the fire.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
